A saved selector may already wrap preprocessing: use that selector as the only frontend, or chain preprocessing once before a bare selector. [RL-0012] Summary tables have one type per column: use NaN, not empty strings, for values that do not apply, or put numeric and categorical summaries in separate columns. Keep at most 50 rows and 12 columns; for wide summaries, place variables in rows and statistics in columns.
[RL-0013] Keep each script short and direct, about 120 lines or fewer: loop over columns instead of repeating blocks, no commented-out alternatives, no long docstrings, no restating of these instructions. A complete short script is better than an elaborate one that is cut off.

A message about specifying columns with strings on non-dataframes means an array reached a name-based transformer (see RL-0009 and RL-0011).
